content: Zeiss Airyscan 2 (32-channel area detector, open pinhole + pixel reassignment + linear deconvolution) achieves ~1.7-fold lateral AND axial resolution improvement over standard confocal, quoted at 140nm x 140nm x 350nm (XYZ) for a representative high-NA configuration; Joint Deconvolution can push lateral to ~90nm. This 1.7x factor is a relative improvement over confocal-at-the-same-NA and is most commonly demonstrated/marketed on high-NA (1.4 oil) objectives; extrapolating the same relative factor to a lower-NA air objective (NA 0.8, as used in this project) is an inference, not a verified Zeiss claim for that specific NA.
